about_the_game:
A groundbreaking real-time grand strategy game with limitless armies, endless cities, and unparalleled resource simulation. Built to redefine wargames and push the boundaries of scale and depth.

Features

  • City Building: Construct and develop your cities to support your war efforts.

  • Defenses: Turtle up with fortifications and guard posts.

  • Resource Management: Set up production chains with a delivery system to ensure a smooth supply of materials.

  • Automate: Setup your medieval industry too keep running while you are busy conquering.

  • Army Controls: Command your forces across the map while keeping them well-supplied and fed.

  • Diverse Military Units: Deploy various unit types, each with its own strengths and weaknesses.

  • Diplomacy system: Coerce others into joining your cause.

  • Incredible scale: Hundreds of thousands of soldiers and workers are simulated in real time.

New from DSS 1

  • Three times the amount of resources, buildings and soldiers.

  • A skill and level up system.

  • Technology tree.

  • Free building of walls and fortifications.

  • A new villain introduces horde waves.

  • Tactical controls during battle.

  • Updated graphics.

  • New soldier AI that moves to avoid terrain and is more active during battle.

  • Ambience sound design.

  • Map editor.

  • Battle Lab: Pit soldiers against each other.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128mb Video Memory, capable of Shader Model 3.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Command armies, build cities, and manage a dynamic economy in this real-time grand strategy game. Establish automated supply routes within your territory to streamline production, fortify defenses, and prepare for intense battles. Will you lead your empire to dominance?
supported_languages: English, German, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Spain
